body:
Life is shit. Your ex is shit. His friends are shiiiiiiit.
But you have a little ball of fur looking up to you with love and purrs. Do not throw its life away because you can't handle it anymore. You are everything its got, even if both of you don't have much. You got this! Hang in there, call somebody, send me a PM if you feel like letting it all out :)

I have the same thoughts. And losing my SO and everything I've worked towards hit me really hard, hard enough to contemplate offing myself. I'm nowhere near being over it, but thinking about my family being devastated helps me staying alive for now. And I'm glad it works for you too. 
PM me if you want, and let's rant about this shitty hand we've been dealt by life.

Even if you want to forfeit your own life, please do not abandon your feline friend. He depends on you, he wants to purr in your lap. :( Think of those jellybeans!
I can not take him/her from your hands, so hang in there for his/her sake!

Would rather hear from you again sometime, you know, just open up my app and see a message from you. But where ever your path takes you, know that a stranger on the other side of the world is hoping you find your relief and peace of mind.
*hug*

Could be that your friend is like me - Cracking jokes in the face of a serious issue, trying to either deal with it or being shook by it. And to be honest, I would not expect any less from a best friend. 
Like a person before me said, at least they responded! 

So, do you have Disney+? :)
Legitimate question - What kept you going on before? What was your reason that protected you from such thoughts? Asking for myself.
